summary: Evidence garbage collection recognizes protected tag deletion refusals even when long push output places the GH013 marker outside the last 300 characters.

schema.detail: No record or plan format changes.

rules.detail: Deletion errors are classified using the full redacted push output. Only displayed failure diagnostics are truncated; protected evidence groups remain intact.

compatibility.detail: Existing diagnostic length limits and credential redaction are preserved.

recovery.detail: Reverting restores the prior diagnostic classification behavior; no data recovery is needed.
